newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus to auction 30 mln pounds of 91 day t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus to auction 30 mln pounds of 91 day t-bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will auction up to 30 million pounds worth ($58.5 million) of 91 day treasury bills with a June 25 issue date, it said on Thursday.
Competitive or non competitive bids for the issue can be made from June 23 to June 25 at 0900 local (0600 GMT).

The central bank defines competitive bids as those where the bidder will set the price they are willing to pay to buy the bills. The bid can be accepted either in part or in whole if the price set is equal or higher than the price set by the central bank for the specific issue.
Non competitive bids, which have to be marked as such, are those where the bidder states his intention to purchase bills at the average price of competitive bids accepted by the central bank.
